summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game spanning Level 0's yellow maze, the Habitable Zone, Utility Halls and the Electrical Station. Shared player behaviors own survival, combat, social interaction and progression; place simulations generate and maintain local worlds, while player state persists across places and NPCs hold their own relationships, gear and behavior state.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and safe-room hub; generated maze plus authored cells, loot furniture, shifting walls, stairs and sim-managed smilers/lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; sim manages the car-park layout, camp agents, shelf/wall loot furniture and hounds/skin-stealers.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls/rooms, supplies, NPCs and the Level 3 threshold.

places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station and Base Gamma; seeded maze with barred edges and 1 m arched crawl halls, hazards, searchable wall furniture, station models, hound brigades and deathmoth swarms.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry and default main place; declares camera, player, input actions and HUD wiring.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain: locomotion, player, interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, critter.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - look camera owning yaw/pitch and smoothed crouch eye height.
places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level3/sim.js, places/debug/sim.js - per-place setup and simulation tick roots.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place config and authored placements; main, level1 and debug have authored cell sets.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/loot-ui.js, talk-ui.js, build-ui.js, stats-ui.js and noclip-ui.js - HUD composition and action routing for survival, social, loot, build and stats panels.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml; scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with their data - per-level grids/layouts reused by simulation, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + scripts/lib/data/level3.yml + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - deterministic Electrical Station grid/zones/open edges and routes used by geometry, sim, player and creatures.
scripts/lib/level3-arch.js - vault mesh helper used by Level 3 structural and detail geometry for crawl-hall brick arches.

scripts/lib/furniture.js + scripts/lib/data/furniture-loot.yml - searchable loot furniture placement/container factory shared by Level 0, Level 1 and Level 3 simulations; Level 2 retains its separate container path.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapons.js; weapon-look.js, weapon-prof.js and weapon-geo.js - weapon definitions and fitted variants shared by pickups, viewmodels and NPCs.
scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/loot3.js - shared token vocabulary and general loot, with Level 3-specific tables, pages, garments and weapons.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml; scripts/lib/stats.js - worn-slot/armor helpers and HALOGEN derivations reused by player, NPC combat, loot and UI.
scripts/lib/npc-talk.js + scripts/lib/data/talk.yml and shops.yml - dialogue policy/model prompt parsing, rolls, NPC voice/name and trader stock/pricing helpers for talk.js and talk-ui.js.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level3/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - cadence and tick; simulations own local setup/ticking.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; scripts/lib/maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/level3-arch.js - vault; scripts/lib/furniture.js - sizeOf, pickKind, spawnFurniture, wallSpot0/1/3.
scripts/lib/breakables.js - strike, damageEntity, damageWall, rollDrops, spawnRubble, syncLevel0 and material/tool helpers.
scripts/build.js - onInput, update; scripts/build-ui.js - buildUi; scripts/ui.js - default render and plyUpload.
scripts/lib/loot3.js - rollWeaponL3, rollTableL3, rollItemL3, spawnCrateL3; scripts/deathmoths.js - update.
scripts/player.js - survival/combat/token and reload APIs; scripts/interact.js - openLoot, talk, onInput, update; scripts/talk.js - heard, onInput, update.
scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe; scripts/lib/clothes.js and scripts/lib/stats.js - apparel and HALOGEN helpers; scripts/stats-ui.js - statsUi.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, health/survival, visited cells/zones, kills/deaths, equipment/inventory/ammo/condition, clothes, compass and Level 3 consumable/page fields; crouch and detect are also player state.
scripts/stats.js - player.state owns HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates the sheet and spends points.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.

scripts/interact.js - player focus, loot menu, notices and interaction; NPCs own pockets/picked and per-player warned/angry state, containers own item lists/lock/scavenged state, and looted bodies' look drives worn clothing.
scripts/talk.js - player state holds talkWith, shopOpen, talks, subtitle and busy/mood fields; NPC state holds rapport, line/talk target, follow, per-player anger/discount/gift and trader stock.
scripts/critter.js - player.state.look owns appearance/worn slots; avatar scratch is local/session state.
Place simulations - place.state owns seed flags and local refill/respawn/hazard schedules; Level 3 also tracks layoutV/furnitureSeeded, generators, line output and actor managers.
Creature/NPC entity state - smilers, lurkers, hounds, stealers, deathmoths and meg-agent own health/death, rolled stats, drops and behavior flags; movement/path scratch is session-local.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js chain: locomotion reads prior movement; player owns movement/survival/combat; interact handles use; talk handles dialogue/shop; then build, noclip, stats and critter behaviors.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and crouched eye height; player/enemy gaze and targeting consume camera direction/state.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; later thresholds connect Level 1 to 2 and Level 2 to 3; Level 3 BACK door returns to Level 2 via scripts/level-door.js.

interact.js focus/E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; scripts/talk-ui.js sends typed text/actions through talk/talkdo/shop inputs to scripts/talk.js; talk.js submits llm:chat and its heard handler validates reply/checks before rapport changes.
talk.js writes NPC state.line and player subtitle → scripts/talk-ui.js / scripts/ui.js; NPC voice is emitted nearby; shop actions update almond water, inventory and NPC stock.
interact.js crouched E near NPC → Sneak roll and NPC pockets → player.js takeToken/player inventory; caught attempts warn/shove and repeat caught theft turns that NPC hostile.
interact loot of a body → player inventory and scripts/interact.js strips removed clothing from the body's look/primitive params; stats/clothes helpers resolve NPC worn gear and armor.

place simulations and enemy deaths → scripts/lib/loot.js or loot3.js → weapon/clothing/item tokens → floor entities or searchable containers; main/level1/level3 sims seed searchable furniture through scripts/lib/furniture.js.
player.js attack → scripts/lib/breakables.js → entity hp or Level 0 wall hp/broken keys; rubble becomes containers and main/sim syncs wall geometry; BUILD spends scrap and places breakable pieces.

scripts/lib/level3.js and level3 data → places/level3/sim.js geometry, details, checkpoints and hazards; sim places Blender-built models, starts hound/deathmoth managers and spawns station actors; maze3path routes creatures across open edges.

Level 3 sim layoutV migration clears/re-lays layout-attached hazards and loot furniture after grid changes, and moves loose loot in tight cells to their centerlines; Level 3 loot3 tokens are consumed by player.js and rendered by UI.
scripts/player.js useCompass → scripts/lib/compass.js chooses place exits and writes compassRead → scripts/ui.js timed bearing/readout; player death clears local NPC angry/warned/fresh grudges.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - Level 0 pack managers with distinct gaze/light/sanity reactions; lurkers use uploaded animated mesh at scale 1.23 (2.4 m), including debug test placement.
scripts/hounds.js + hound-geo.js - shared Level 1/2/3 hound AI with rigged hound-v2 mesh; safe zones and grids vary by place, Level 3 brigades use maze routing and stun state.
scripts/stealers.js + stealer-geo.js - Level 1 skin-stealer behavior swaps legacy rows to rigged mesh; disguise/creature/shed parts and reveal animation vary by skin-to-hunt phase.
scripts/meg-agent.js + scripts/critter2-geo.js - common NPC avatar and behavior varies by species/look, role, voice, weapon and place; used by M.E.G., Survivors and Gamma agents.
scripts/lib/weapons.js + weapon-look.js + weapon-prof.js + weapon-geo.js + viewmodel-geo.js - weapon kinds reuse fitted bodies with variant stats/tint/overlays and viewmodel framing.

scripts/lib/furniture.js + loot-bags-geo.js + l2-props-geo.js - searchable containers share item/lock state and placement API, with kind-specific shape/material/loot tables; separate from breakable office furniture in main.
scripts/deathmoths.js + templates/deathmoths.js - one Level 3 manager steers multiple swarms; each uses three rigged moth models and clips, while swarms vary by home and target.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; place terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references are visible; terrain is off.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m with hub cells 26–29; Level 1 is 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 is 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 is 26×26 at 4 m. Keep geometry, zones, exits and routes aligned.

Level 3 tight cells are 1 m clear width (tightHalf 0.5), 1.6 m springline and 2.15 m crown; tightArms/tightSpans drive both structural/detail vaults, and gates/furniture are excluded from crawl halls.

Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, talk.js, build.js, noclip.js, stats.js and critter.js; locomotion reads movement before player control writes velocity.
Weapon ids remain kind or kind~variant across inventory, condition, magazines and entities; use baseOf only where base-kind framing/behavior is intended.

Building scrap is a per-kind player.state.scrap object, unlike comma-separated inventory/container tokens; breakables need tag plus state.mat/hp/maxHp, and Level 0 wall hp/broken state is separate place.state data.
Level 3 layoutV/furnitureSeeded migrations deliberately clear and respawn attached furniture/hazards when the seeded layout changes; keep those migration versions and the new grid placement in sync.
